title: The King Leads The Way
verse: he got up from the meal, removed his outer clothes, took a towel and tied it around himself. He poured water into the washbasin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to dry them with the towel he had wrapped around himself.
observation: Only someone who is truly confident in who they are can humble themselves to serve others. If you don’t know who you are, you end up serving as a means of gaining identity. You try to impress people or try to earn someone’s approval. Jesus didn’t do any of this. He took the stance of a servant and washed their feet. He did this as an example of how they should serve one another. He wasn’t saying we should go around washing people’s feet. (Don’t even ask.) He was saying we should always reach out and serve our brothers and sisters in faith.
application: Look for ways to serve a fellow Christ-follower today.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for serving us by giving Your Life. That’s the greatest gift.
